heard: A space probe ended a 10-year chase at walking speed. The European Space Agency launched Rosetta on a billion-year omission. It whipped past Earth and Mars to build deep space speed. After 10 years, it reached a bizarre duck-shaped comet. Rosetta became the first spacecraft to orbit a comet nucleus. It dropped the lander Philae, which bounced against a cliff. As solar power faded, engineers guided the probe down. Rosetta touched the comet's surface at 2 miles per hour. That is how a space probe ended a 10-year chase at walking speed.
